title: UTCS Address
description: Address structure for jurisdiction resolution. An address MUST carry enough for the provider to resolve a taxing jurisdiction: either a text address sufficient for validation (line1, city, postal_code, country) or geocoordinates (latitude, longitude, country). A postal code alone is not sufficient. UTCS sets this minimum input; the provider performs the resolution.

line1.description: Street address. REQUIRED when latitude/longitude are not provided. The literal value "General Delivery" is accepted for locations without a registered street address.

line3.description: Third address line. Common in international addresses (building name, floor, district).

city.description: City or locality. REQUIRED when latitude/longitude are not provided.

region.description: State, province, or region. REQUIRED for US, CA, AU, IN. ISO 3166-2 subdivision code recommended.

postal_code.description: Postal or ZIP code. REQUIRED when using the text address path. A postal code alone is never sufficient for jurisdiction resolution.

latitude.description: Latitude coordinate. REQUIRED when line1/city are not provided. When provided, coordinates take precedence for jurisdiction resolution.

longitude.description: Longitude coordinate. REQUIRED when line1/city are not provided.

location_code.description: Identifier of a registered business location (outlet, store, warehouse) at this address. Optional. Used where a jurisdiction requires outlet-level attribution for local reporting; the provider maps it to the registered location it has on file.
